description: This PHP file defines the WeightClass controller for the Opencart admin localizations module. It handles listing, viewing, creating, updating, and deleting weight class data, including generating views and API responses.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing weight classes in the Opencart admin panel, including CRUD operations and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the main weight class management page, including setting up breadcrumbs and loading partial views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Triggers loading of the weight class list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of weight classes, including pagination and actions.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a weight class, preloading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing weight class, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected weight classes if permitted, with checks for default or in-use weight classes.
